module.utilitysuite.dot_commands.descrip: Chat lines starting with . are handled locally and never sent: .t <module>, .goal <text>, .stop, .list, .help
module.utilitysuite.offhand_manager.desc: Keeps a totem at low health or while gliding, a shield against ranged threats, else your preferred offhand item
module.utilitysuite.auto_fish.descriptio: Reels in on a bite and recasts with human delays; stops before the rod breaks or the inventory fills
module.utilitysuite.auto_respawn.descrip: Respawns after a short delay and prints the death coordinates (never on hardcore)
module.utilitysuite.auto_reconnect.descr: Reconnects after an unexpected disconnect with a countdown and backoff, then resumes the running job
